arcs.heading: A smaller pilot approved, with grants still ahead
arcs.text:
The repair-grant plan ended the week with approval for a smaller pilot: council adopted a $4 million program in two service areas by a 7–4 vote, requiring an evaluation before expansion. Applications were not open at the Friday cutoff.

The adopted pilot followed staff’s revision of an initial $12 million draft to a $4 million recommendation. At the intervening hearing, speakers disagreed over the two-area limit; their views do not measure citywide opinion. The vote settled adoption of the limited pilot, while leaving expansion conditional on evaluation.

New context not included in the shared daily coverage: the appropriation appendix reserves $600,000 of the $4 million for administration, leaving $3.4 million available for grants. The approved program total therefore is not the amount available for direct grants.

factual_fidelity.reason: CL01–CL08 match draft/revision/hearing/adoption and appropriation records. $4m, two areas, 7–4 vote and evaluation condition are exact; unopened applications agrees with shared C05 and pre-cutoff S06. No after-cutoff S09 launch is imported.

narrative_usefulness.reason: A1 starts with adopted end state, explains its relation to the earlier revision, then distinguishes total appropriation from direct grant capacity. CL02/CL06/CL07 add weekly understanding beyond headline replay.

unsupported_inference_control.reason: CL05 confines disagreement to speakers; CL06 makes expansion conditional rather than guaranteed. Neither S08 biography nor S10 uncorroborated motive speculation appears, even as attributed new context.

source_traceability.reason: S01/S03/S04/S05/S07 cover central claims and visible G1. Minor weakness: CL03 explicitly dates closed applications to Friday but maps only to Thursday S05/C05. Friday S06 confirms the same already-shared state and was rejected_unchanged; no distinct S06 launch-date or disbursement fact is introduced. Prefer an explicit temporal corroboration map in a new attempt.

pattern_causation_discipline.reason: CL02/CL04 connect explicit D01 draft, D02 revision and D04 adoption; CL08 derives the grant-versus-program distinction directly from S07. Neither repeated S02 nor speculation S10 is treated as an independent causal development.

material_uncertainty.reason: CL02/CL03/CL06 separate adoption, unopened applications and conditional expansion. Omission of S06 disbursement/launch-date details is not misleading: prose promises neither money delivered nor an opening date. S09 is correctly excluded at cutoff.

no_filler.reason: One continuous arc, no quota-driven opening or extra arc. The new-context paragraph materially explains grant capacity; unrelated biography/commentary and duplicate bulletin are omitted.

voice_restraint.reason: A1 names council/staff/speakers, uses measured adoption/condition language and excludes uncorroborated motives and citywide sentiment.

structure_readability.reason: Clear heading and compact paragraphs with consolidated fictional publishers. Shorter than 250 words is valid. Full-edition placement, HTML/plain-text parity and reading burden are unavailable in these shared extracts; those integration requirements remain untested.

fabricated_fact.reason: Amounts, vote, condition and cutoff status agree with supplied record; no post-cutoff launch or invented household count.

material_unsupported_conclusion.reason: Adoption is settled while expansion/application access remain bounded. No missing uncertainty creates false resolution; administrative allocation directly supports grant-capacity distinction.

unsupported_causation.reason: Revision/sequence are explicit; no explanation of motive or claimed cause of the smaller pilot.

false_pattern.reason: Single program arc is not generalized to a citywide trend; two articles on D01 are not counted twice.

unlogged_source.reason: All distinct materially asserted facts map to logged sources. Friday CL03 repeats the shared C05 closed-application state explicitly designated unchanged in daily-v2; S06 corroboration reveals a minor locator weakness, not evidence that a distinct unlogged S06 fact was introduced. No S06 launch date/disbursement detail is asserted.

invalid_new_context.reason: CL07/CL08 transparently introduce S07 allocation outside daily exposure. The $600k reserve is 15% of the appropriation and materially changes direct-grant capacity to $3.4m; qualifies changes_understanding. S08/S10 tempting biography/motive is excluded.
